ns2:course.label: Supervision of Learning Envir
ns2:course.description: Methods, theories, and research applying to the supervision and evaluation of classroom practices in learning-centered schools; includes analysis and application of research in effective teaching practices, formatice assessment and summative evaluation, data collection techniques, and professional development. Prerequisite: EOL 540 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: EOL 540 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC, or EDM: Ed Pol Org & Ldrshp -UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $409.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
